scan_interval.hint: Interval of scanning unregistered stickers (Unit: minutes)

use_hints_pipeline.hint: Phase 0.4 M5 — when true, sticker prompt only describes the <hints_key type=sticker> usage instead of listing every registered sticker. The full candidate list is asynchronously prepared via HintsPipeline and injected on the next turn. Recommended once you have 10+ stickers; leave false to keep the legacy 'list everything in prompt' behaviour while observing for one week.

hints_top_k.hint: Phase 0.4 M5 — when use_hints_pipeline is on, how many sticker candidates to inject per <hints_key>. Pure substring/keyword match against sticker descriptions; ranked by occurrence count then registration order.
